# M03-escalation-fails: No relay: under --disable-approval with the sandbox network off (--sandbox-network restricted, Dim Factory sets it) a command that needs the network fails instead of asking. The side effect is refused (policy_decision deny:network_restricted, x-assumed), the task fails before it starts, its tool.result says why; Muse goes on and completes. No ask ever reaches Dim Factory; exit 0.
# The live check of "escalations fail": the registry lookup needs the network, which --sandbox-network restricted turns off. Shows how a refused connection looks on the wire (a policy deny, or a command that fails). Muse 1.3 was reported to hang on approvals; --timeout bounds the recording, and a hang is the finding (keep synthesized and note it).
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>; Muse signs in with the key, never the everyday sign-in.
# <fixture Muse home> is an isolated folder that stands in for the home (never the everyday one): its .config/muse is the profile recorded.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --muse --muse-home "<fixture Muse home>" --bin "<the muse executable>" --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures/muse/exec/M03-escalation-fails --id M03 --slug escalation-fails --cli-version <muse --version> --timing off --env-file "<a file with META_API_KEY=...>" --pass-file tests/fixtures/muse/recipes/M03-escalation-fails/pass.json --timeout 900000 -- exec --json --prompt-file "<repo>/tests/fixtures/muse/recipes/M03-escalation-fails/prompt.md" --trust-workspace --disable-approval --sandbox-network restricted
